method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the image shows quadrilateral ABCD with A at upper left, B at lower left, C at lower right, D at upper right, and diagonals AC and BD crossing at O. Read from the text that ABCD is a parallelogram and OA=3. Use the parallelogram fact that diagonals bisect each other, so O is the midpoint of AC and AC=2·OA=6. Then use the rectangle characterization: a parallelogram is a rectangle exactly when its diagonals are equal. Therefore require BD=AC=6.

最终答案：BD=6。

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the image shows the diagonals AC and BD meeting at O inside parallelogram ABCD, with B and D lying on the same diagonal line through O. Read from the text that OA=3 and that the desired shape is a rectangle. In a rectangle, the intersection of the diagonals is the center of the circumscribed circle, so O is equidistant from A, B, C, and D. Thus OA is the circle radius, equal to 3. Since B, O, and D are collinear on diagonal BD, BD is a diameter of this circle, so BD=2·3=6.
